dialogues.jp:
月城の育てている草は、特に成長しているよう
には見えない。
dialogues.en:
The plant that Tsukishiro was taking care of, didn't seem to
show any signs of growth.
dialogues.text:
The plant that Tsukishiro was taking care of, didn't seem to
show any signs of growth.

dialogues.jp:
どちらかというと弱々しく、どうにか生きてい
るといったように見える。
dialogues.en:
It looked like it was weak, but still trying it's best to
live.
dialogues.text:
It looked like it was weak, but still trying it's best to
live.

dialogues.jp:
けれど、月城が一生懸命育てているせいだろう。
このまま枯れてしまうという気はしなかった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's taking care of it with all she's got, though. I
don't think it'd die just yet.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's taking care of it with all she's got, though. I
don't think it'd die just yet.

dialogues.jp: しかし、いったい何の花なんだろう。
dialogues.en: I do wonder what kind of flower this is, though.
dialogues.text: I do wonder what kind of flower this is, though.

dialogues.jp:
植物に詳しい訳じゃないけれど、わざわざこん
なところで育てるような植物には見えなかった。
dialogues.en:
Not that I know much about biology, but it seems very
strange for a plant to be growing in this damp, dark place.
dialogues.text:
Not that I know much about biology, but it seems very
strange for a plant to be growing in this damp, dark place.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉、先輩」
dialogues.en: "...Asakura, senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Asakura, senpai."

dialogues.jp: ふと、背後から小さな声が聞こえる。
dialogues.en: From behind me, a tiny voice broke the silence.
dialogues.text: From behind me, a tiny voice broke the silence.

dialogues.jp:
こんなひとけのない場所でなければ、気づかな
かったかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
In this deserted place, there's no mistaking who it belonged
to.
dialogues.text:
In this deserted place, there's no mistaking who it belonged
to.

dialogues.jp: 「よぅ、月城」
dialogues.en: "Yo, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Yo, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……何してるの」
dialogues.en: "...What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "...What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「いや、この花の様子を見に来ただけだよ。一
　応、順調に育ってるみたいだぞ？」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing, just checking on the plant. For now, it seems to
be growing, doesn't it?"
dialogues.text:
"Nothing, just checking on the plant. For now, it seems to
be growing, doesn't it?"

dialogues.jp:
一応、というのは、やはりこの草が元気には見
えなかったからだ。
dialogues.en:
I was lying through my teeth, of course; this plant didn't
seem like it was enjoying life at all.
dialogues.text:
I was lying through my teeth, of course; this plant didn't
seem like it was enjoying life at all.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……よかった」
dialogues.en: "...That's good."
dialogues.text: "...That's good."

dialogues.jp: 月城が俺の横に来て、しゃがむ。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro stopped beside me, and squatted down.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro stopped beside me, and squatted down.

dialogues.jp:
まじまじと、その草を見つめ、何か呟いている
のか、時々『うん、うん』と頷いているのが聞
こえた。
dialogues.en:
Her gaze never left the plant as she whispered things to it,
and would nod to it from time to time.
dialogues.text:
Her gaze never left the plant as she whispered things to it,
and would nod to it from time to time.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだか、よくわからんが、大事な草なんだ
　な……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, I don't know much, but it seems to be an important
plant..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, I don't know much, but it seems to be an important
plant..."

dialogues.jp: 月城が、こくんと頷く。
dialogues.en: Another wordless nod.
dialogues.text: Another wordless nod.

dialogues.jp:
「俺は、そろそろ帰るけど、月城はどうする？
　一緒に帰るか？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm heading back now... what about you? Want to go
together?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm heading back now... what about you? Want to go
together?"

dialogues.jp: 月城はちらりと俺の顔を見て、
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro glanced at my face from the side.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro glanced at my face from the side.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...It's fine."
dialogues.text: "...It's fine."

dialogues.jp: と言い、また草の方だけを見つめ始めた。
dialogues.en: And with that, returned to her vegetation-staring.
dialogues.text: And with that, returned to her vegetation-staring.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ちょっと年寄り臭いかなと思いつつも、
『よっ』と声を出し、立ち上がる。
dialogues.en:
Like a geriatric, I took a deep breath before I got to my
feet.
dialogues.text:
Like a geriatric, I took a deep breath before I got to my
feet.

dialogues.jp: 「あんまり遅くならないウチに帰れよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't go home too late, okay?"
dialogues.text: "Don't go home too late, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp:
そして、『じゃあな』と声をかけ、鞄を肩に背
負い、彼女に背を向ける。
dialogues.en:
With a "later", I slung my bag over my shoulder and started
heading back.
dialogues.text:
With a "later", I slung my bag over my shoulder and started
heading back.

dialogues.speaker: Piros
dialogues.jp: 「先輩、気をつけて帰ってね！」
dialogues.en: "Senpai, take care!"
dialogues.text: "Senpai, take care!"

dialogues.jp: 背中の向こうから、人形の声が聞こえた。
dialogues.en: The doll's voice called out to me from behind.
dialogues.text: The doll's voice called out to me from behind.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、もう一度、
dialogues.en: I opened my mouth once again,
dialogues.text: I opened my mouth once again,

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあな」
dialogues.en: "See you later."
dialogues.text: "See you later."

dialogues.jp: と言い、手を振った。
dialogues.en: And closed it again, while waving.
dialogues.text: And closed it again, while waving.

dialogues.jp: ◆大切な花◆
dialogues.en: ◆Important Flower◆
dialogues.text: ◆Important Flower◆

dialogues.jp: 体育館裏に、月城の草の様子を見に行く。
dialogues.en:
I went to the back of the gym again, to check on
Tsukishiro's plant's condition.
dialogues.text:
I went to the back of the gym again, to check on
Tsukishiro's plant's condition.

dialogues.jp:
あまり元気には見えないが、徐々に育っている
ように見えた。
dialogues.en:
It didn't look like it was doing too well, but seemed to be
growing bit by bit.
dialogues.text:
It didn't look like it was doing too well, but seemed to be
growing bit by bit.

dialogues.jp:
後から月城がやってきて、いつものように、
じーっとその草を見つめ始めた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro then came by, and as usual, squatted down next to
it and stared.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro then came by, and as usual, squatted down next to
it and stared.

dialogues.jp:
彼女にとって、その草は何よりも大切なものの
ようだ。
dialogues.en: That flower seems very important to her.
dialogues.text: That flower seems very important to her.
